rules.name: Crash
rules.description: An exception that stopped a thread

rules.name: Database connection never established
rules.description: A connection did not succeed within 5 s. The (\d+) groups tie the two lines of one connection.

rules.name: Request never answered
rules.description: A request without its end within 10 s

rules.name: Retry storm
rules.description: The same request retried 3 times or more within 60 s

rules.name: Database errors open the circuit breaker
rules.description: A database error, then the circuit breaker opening within 30 s: the ledger is cut off

rules.name: Login then logout within 1 s
rules.description: Same user: a session that ends right away often means a broken token

rules.name: Clock set
rules.description: Times before and after this line can not be compared

rules.name: Android: app not responding
rules.description: The main thread of an app was blocked
